points.description: Setup: labels data as +/- (e.g. +1/-1) and initializes the weights (randomly or otherwise).

Loop over the data/epochs, applying the update rule: if a point is misclassified (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for the correct-sign x), update w += eta*x (or equivalent w += eta*y*x), repeating until weights stop changing / no misclassifications. Equivalent wording and correct equivalent update forms earn the mark.
